objectives: Course Objective 	This course aims to teach students intermediate-level macroeconomic tools and apply them to real-world economic policy issues. Macroeconomics is concerned with the behavior of the aggregate economy. We will be examining macroeconomic data and studying models designed to help us comprehend it. We will pay attention to the role of policymakers in shaping macroeconomic outcomes. In this course, we will be employing graphs primarily with basic level of calculus.
